_comment: World map technology tree. Each branch takes 2 columns (slot 0 and 1); 'era' is the row. Effects stack - see TECH_EFFECT_INFO in gui/campaigns/grand_strategy/game/TechTree.js.

research._comment: Points per turn = base + perProvinceSqrt * sqrt(provinces) + perAcademy * academies, times (1 + research bonus).

_oceanComment: Open-ocean sea provinces: require Ocean Navigation. All other seas are coastal (Shipbuilding).

technologies.name: Beaten Paths
technologies.description: Trails between villages let armies store more movement.

technologies.name: Pack Animals
technologies.description: Mules and oxen carry supplies, speeding up the march.

technologies.name: Paved Roads
technologies.description: Stone roads link the cities of the realm.

technologies.name: Quartermasters
technologies.description: Supply depots sustain more than one army in the field.

technologies.name: Imperial Roads
technologies.description: A road network with relay stations crosses the whole territory.

technologies.name: Professional Army
technologies.description: Paid soldiers trained full-time.

technologies.name: Forced Marches
technologies.description: Disciplined legions march day and night.

technologies.name: Military Engineering
technologies.description: Field fortifications and permanent garrisons.

technologies.name: Shipbuilding
technologies.description: Boats able to follow the coast. Allows entering coastal seas.

technologies.name: Fishing
technologies.description: Nets and fishing boats enrich the coastal provinces.

technologies.name: Amphibious Landing
technologies.description: Troops trained to land under enemy fire. Allows invading enemy land from the sea.

technologies.name: Merchant Ports
technologies.description: Amphorae and merchants fill the harbours.

technologies.name: Ocean Navigation
technologies.description: High-hulled ships brave the open sea. Allows entering oceans.

technologies.name: Cartography
technologies.description: Accurate maps reveal more distant lands.

technologies.name: Winds and Monsoons
technologies.description: Knowing the seasonal winds makes sea voyages faster.

technologies.name: Global Trade Routes
technologies.description: Merchant fleets link distant continents.

technologies.name: Irrigation
technologies.description: Canals bring water to the fields.

technologies.name: Coinage
technologies.description: Coins make collecting taxes easier.

technologies.name: Crop Rotation
technologies.description: Rested fields yield larger harvests.

technologies.name: Mining
technologies.description: Metal mines and quarries make construction cheaper.

technologies.name: Aqueducts
technologies.description: Clean water for the cities.

technologies.name: Accounting
technologies.description: Accurate records lower the cost of keeping garrisons.

technologies.name: Monetary Economy
technologies.description: Banks and credit multiply the wealth of the empire.

technologies.name: Great Works
technologies.description: Master builders raise structures in record time.

technologies.name: Writing
technologies.description: The written record preserves knowledge.

technologies.name: Code of Laws
technologies.description: Clear laws keep the people calm.

technologies.name: Philosophy
technologies.description: Schools of thought speed up discoveries.

technologies.name: Bureaucracy
technologies.description: Officials and tax collectors administer the provinces.

technologies.name: Census
technologies.description: Counting the people means knowing how much they can pay.

technologies.name: Patriotism
technologies.description: National pride attracts volunteers and keeps order.

technologies.name: Great Library
technologies.description: All the world's knowledge gathered in one place.

technologies.name: Centralized Empire
technologies.description: A strong government controls every corner of the empire.
